notes.title: Free Story Mode and quality of life update
notes.content:
Hello,
Thank you for 1 year of beating the Stickman!

Here are some things new coming to the game:

[list]
[*][b]Story Mode:[/b] we've rebalanced the game to reduce the significant amount of grind required to unlock all story content. There is a lot of cool stuff we bet lots of you have missed because of the extreme grinding, now it's the time to experience them for yourself. The Story Mode will come as a free DLC.
[*][b]Quality of life update:[/b] to make your experience go even more smooth, we've made many small changes to the game like adding Dark mode, adding Windowed mode, and you now can use both mouse click or keyboard for in-game Tap and Hold.
[*][b]Deep discount:[/b] to give the opportunity to beat the Stickman to more players, we scheduled a limited-time deep discount on the base game. Wishlist the game and the DLC now so you won't miss it!
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated - version 12.15, Task Manager and more...
notes.content:
Play the Demo now and have a look at the Task system of the game. Task system gives you many things to do daily, weekly, and for a lifetime. It is great for keeping you busy, earning big amounts of currencies, and keeping track of main and side stories.

If you've played the demo version before, you may want to clear your data to enjoy this update. Just follow these steps:

1. Disable cloud save: right-click on the game in your Steam's library, select Properties, and then untick the cloud save option.

2. Delete the game's save: by going to the game's save folder and deleting ALL of its content. Here are the save folder's locations on different platforms:
- On Windows: %userprofile%\appdata\locallow\Mini Fun Games\Beat Stickman Beyond Demo
- On Linux+SteamOS: ~/.config/unity3d/Mini Fun Games/Beat Stickman Beyond Demo
- On MacOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Mini Fun Games/Beat Stickman Beyond Demo

notes.title: Demo updated - version 12.13.10
notes.content:
- Now you have achievements to unlock.
- Now you can unlock all the demo weapons more easily. Previously it was nearly impossible to do so because the demo version doesn't have many luxuries that you can unlock to help boost your progress like in the full version. But with the new content added to the demo, now it is possible.

[b]Up Next: [/b] we're preparing the Roadmap, it will be published soon. You will love it.
